The modern Olympic Games were revived in **1896** in **Athens, Greece**.

This historic event was organized by Baron Pierre de Coubertin, who championed the idea of bringing back the ancient Greek tradition to foster peace and international understanding through sport. The first Games were held from April 6 to April 15, 1896, at the Panathenaic Stadium, which was constructed entirely of marble to honor the ancient origins of the games.

I hope that helps! If you're interested in learning more about the specific events of those first Games or the countries that participated, just let me know.
